name: founder-ide-extension
description: Registers the Founder OS AI Gateway as a first-class VS Code chat model provider. Streams tokens from your own routing layer into the built-in Chat view. Works in Cursor, VSCodium, stock VS Code, and Windsurf.

chatParticipants.name: FounderOS
chatParticipants.description: Chat with the Founder OS AI Gateway (routed via your node)

languageModelTools.name: founder.editFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edit a file in the workspace by replacing oldText with newText. Use absolute paths. Set createIfMissing=true to create the file if it does not exist. The change is applied via vscode.workspace.applyEdit and is reviewable in the editor.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit or create a workspace file (Founder OS)

filePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the file to edit.

oldText.description: The exact text to replace. Empty string means append to end of file.

newText.description: The new text to insert in place of oldText.

createIfMissing.description: If true, create the file when it does not exist.

languageModelTools.name: founder.runCommand
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in a VS Code terminal and return its combined stdout+stderr output. The command runs in the workspace root by default. Use for build, test, lint, and inspection commands. Confirm with the user before destructive commands.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a terminal command and capture output (Founder OS)

cwd.description: Optional working directory (absolute or workspace-relative). Defaults to the workspace root.

timeoutMs.description: Max milliseconds to wait for completion. Default 30000, max 300000.

languageModelTools.name: founder.readWorkspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Walk the current workspace file tree and return a compact summary (respecting common ignore patterns like node_modules and .git). Optionally include the full contents of a small set of files via readFiles. Use this to ground yourself in the repo structure before editing.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the workspace file tree (Founder OS)

subdir.description: Optional workspace-relative sub-directory to walk. Defaults to the workspace root.

readFiles.description: Optional list of workspace-relative files whose full contents to include (max 10).

maxTreeEntries.description: Max file-tree entries to return. Default 400, max 5000.

founderOs.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Founder OS API base URL. If empty, the extension reads `apiBaseUrl` from `~/FounderVault/node-config.json`.

founderOs.nodeId.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Founder Node ID. If empty, the extension reads `nodeId` from `~/FounderVault/node-config.json`.

founderOs.nodeToken.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Founder Node token. If empty, the extension reads `nodeToken` from `~/FounderVault/node-config.json`.

founderOs.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for gateway calls (including streaming).
